response.title: SlopSieve Extension — Spot the slop in your feed
response.text:
SlopSieve Extension — Spot the slop in your feed

# Slop Sieve for your browser

A spam filter for the AI age — running in your browser.

## What it does

SlopSieve adds a small verdict badge next to posts in your feed, labelling the ones that look like bot-generated, AI-generated, or low-quality content. Click any badge to see the breakdown — which signals fired, the account's score, the text's score, and the combined meta-verdict.

The goal is a quieter feed. Pick one of three modes from the toolbar popup: Off just shows the badges, Dim fades flagged posts so you can hover to read them, and Hide collapses them to a small click-to-show stub.

## Why it's different

- On-device scoring The ML model runs inside your browser. Your feed is not sent to a server for scoring.
- Multi-platform One extension covers X, Bluesky, LinkedIn, Reddit (new + old), and Hacker News. Same verdict model, consistent badges.
- No telemetry No analytics, no heartbeats, no third-party SDKs. Scoring makes zero background requests.
- Adjustable filtering Off, Dim, or Hide — pick how aggressive the UI treatment should be from the toolbar popup.
- No account Install and it works. There is nothing to sign up for.
- Opt-in remote features Right-click "Score selection with SlopSieve" or "Inspect this page on SlopSieve" to send one-off text or URLs to slopsieve.com for a prediction. Everything else stays local.

## Install

Available on the official browser stores:

The Chrome listing also covers Edge, Brave, Arc, and other Chromium-based browsers. The Firefox listing covers desktop Firefox and Firefox for Android.

## Privacy

Scoring runs fully on your device. Nothing about your feed is sent anywhere as part of normal use.

Three features do contact slopsieve.com, and only when you explicitly invoke them:

- Right-click → "Score selection with SlopSieve" → sends your selected text (≤1500 chars) to slopsieve.com/score.
- Right-click → "Inspect this page on SlopSieve" → sends the current tab's URL and title to slopsieve.com/inspect.
- Flagging an account → sends the account ID, your label, and optional reason text to api.slopsieve.com.

Full extension privacy policy: slopsieve.com/extension-privacy. Site-wide privacy and imprint: slopsieve.com/legal.

## Support

Bug reports, feature requests, and questions: email thomas.friedel@gmail.com. Please include your browser and the extension version (visible on the settings drawer).
